micro.name: Micro Finance Scheme
micro.description: Ideal for small business and agricultural needs. Covers up to ₹1.40 lakh at a low interest rate with a short moratorium period.

term.name: Term Loan Scheme
term.description: Suitable for medium-scale business and agri-allied projects. Covers up to ₹50 lakh with a 6-month repayment holiday.

edu.name: Educational Loan Scheme
edu.description: Designed for higher education financing. Covers up to ₹20 lakh with a 12-month moratorium (or course duration + 1 year).
